title: Proving olympiad geometry theorems on a superconducting quantum processor
summary: Automated theorem proving seeks to use computational systems to prove or disprove mathematical and logical statements [1, 2]. It underpins a wide range of applications, and enhancing theorem-proving capabilities remains a central objective in artificial intelligence [3]. Although recent neuro-symbolic systems have achieved remarkable progress [4-7], their operation is ultimately constrained by classical computational architectures.
